findings.evidence: Finite.lean:19-23 and :93 versus the PR description's own text: "The general case needs a different argument (excellence, or N-2 finiteness for finitely generated algebras over a field) and is not claimed." Noether finiteness (Eisenbud, Commutative Algebra, Cor. 13.13) applies here since W₂.CoordinateRing is a f.g. F-algebra domain (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/Affine/Point.lean:206 gives IsDomain) and finiteness of W₁.FunctionField/W₂.FunctionField is Finite.lean:70. The sibling IntermediateRing/Basic.lean:54-58 states the limitation correctly ("Every route to it in Mathlib ... carries an Algebra.IsSeparable hypothesis") without claiming necessity.
findings.fix: Reword to what the PR description already says: the result is expected to hold without separability, but the only proof available in Mathlib is IsIntegralClosure.finite, which requires it; the general case (excellence / N-2 finiteness for finitely generated algebras over a field) is not available upstream and is left as separate work. Drop "genuine hypothesis rather than an artefact of the proof" at lines 19 and 93, and change "degenerates exactly on purely inseparable extensions" to "degenerates on inseparable extensions".
findings.issue: "Separability is a genuine hypothesis rather than an artefact of the proof" is mathematically false. W₂.CoordinateRing = F[X,Y]/(W) is a finitely generated domain over the field F and W₁.FunctionField is finite over W₂.FunctionField (proved on line 70 of this file), so Noether's finiteness theorem gives module-finiteness of the integral closure with no separability hypothesis, Frobenius included. The hypothesis is an artefact of the only route Mathlib provides. Repeated at line 93 ("Separability is a genuine hypothesis — see the module docstring"). The same sentence also misstates the trace-form fact: the trace form degenerates on every inseparable finite extension, not only purely inseparable ones.

summary: The two new statements are faithful: hypotheses match IsIntegralClosure.finite's actual requirements, the free algebra instance is pinned by the scalar tower, and the coordinate-to-field transport via IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext is correct. The module docstring, however, asserts a false mathematical claim — that separability is necessary rather than an artefact of the Mathlib route.
